purpose: Project grove nexus variants and quarry Mine Tunnels from their matching surface regions. Apply path themes to all paths on cave levels 1 and 2; roads and buildings remain cave walls.

scope.pathCoverage: All eligible path geometry on levels 1 and 2, independent of park/nexus proximity; never roads or levels 3+.
scope.buildingAndRoadTerrain: Houses, temples and road footprints remain CAVE_WALL. Do not mirror building interiors or carve these footprints for nexus layouts.
scope.standaloneShrines: Retain the explicitly designed Ember altar and Toad idol as freestanding cave interactables, not temple buildings or mirrored houses.

source.regions: Stable generated surface nexus anchors and their original coverage; select by nexus kind rather than any nearby park, seep or rock terrain.
exclude: parking aisles pruned by current pipeline
all roads, including minor, street and service roads
water crossings and bridge spans without an explicit underground connector
source.pathSelection: Use the existing path-class predicate for every path; context selects a theme, not whether a path receives one.
source.nexusMappingPolicy: The four grove variants apply only beneath grove nexuses. Quarry regions always use Mine Tunnels; seep regions receive none of these nexus variants.

identity.inputs: generated surface metadata at every depth; independent of player position, tile clipping, restoration and dug walls

nexusVariants.name: Underground Spring Cave
nexusVariants.layout: central spring feeding a surrounding pool, dry circular bank, mushroom ring, outer stone ring; four open radial approaches
nexusVariants.interaction: proposed watering-can refill from the nearest reachable pool bank; source and pool share one interaction identity; no free healing
nexusVariants.reward: reuse a surviving mirrored POI cache; no extra daily chest

nexusVariants.name: Goblin Warrens
nexusVariants.layout: Vary room width and depth independently across offset rows: 3×3 to 5×5 interiors, including narrow rectangles. Connect shared-wall doors into loops; reserve entrance, exit, stairs and shrine approaches before fitting corner stores.
nexusVariants.interaction: Clear sentries, visit Ember altar for existing fireball boon, break stores and mine optional collapse.
nexusVariants.reward: reuse a surviving mirrored POI cache; barrels replace allocated finite containers

nexusVariants.name: Underground Mushroom Cavern
nexusVariants.layout: Clear central court and four open approaches. Harvestable beds remain outside the walking lanes.
nexusVariants.interaction: Harvest cave mushrooms and visit the Toad idol for its existing Mending boon.
nexusVariants.reward: Toad idol grants its existing Mending regeneration boon. At most one surviving mirrored cache; mushroom harvests replace ordinary cave mushroom seats.

nexusVariants.name: Gemstone Cavern
nexusVariants.layout: Four clear approaches and a central court. Mixed mineral pockets occupy the edges; preserve any surviving mirrored cache on reachable floor.
nexusVariants.interaction: Mine mixed gemstone pockets under their existing deposit or ore-rock rules.
nexusVariants.reward: Sapphire clusters use the existing gem-only deposit. Ruby, emerald and diamond seats currently show the corresponding shipping gem-bearing ore rocks, retaining their metal and chance-gem drops. Dedicated gem-only versions need new world art and deposit rows.
nexusVariants.depthPolicy: Levels 1 and 2 only. The mixed-tier art showcase must be filtered by floor eligibility and existing mining rules before activation.

nexusVariants.name: Mine Tunnels
nexusVariants.layout: Fit ore pockets around existing walkable cave routes and stairs within quarry coverage. House and road footprints stay rock walls; do not carve them to join deposits.
nexusVariants.interaction: Mine a simple ore-rich deposit using existing floor-tier ore and mining rules.
nexusVariants.reward: Mine finite ore deposits appropriate to the floor tier; preview shows depth 2 copper. The quarry anchor owns one depth-qualified deposit budget. No added shrine, temple, cache or surface quarry first-rock reward.

routeVariants.contextPolicy: Theme affinity only; paths outside this context still receive an underground path variant.
routeVariants.layout: One-cell clear centre; follows actual path bends and junctions.

routeVariants.mechanic: bank beside small impassable pools; always retain a dry connection

routeVariants.reward: Refill from reachable banks. Scattered rocks use game mineral-rock art and existing finite cave-rock allocations; water rocks can be mined from the adjacent dry bank. No extra daily reward or cache.
routeVariants.contextPolicy: Theme affinity only; paths outside this context still receive an underground path variant.

routeVariants.mechanic: mineable side alcoves; rare existing supply cache allocation

routeVariants.reward: Bonus metal ore follows the floor level tier; the illustration shows depth 2 copper. Quarry sapphire pockets retain their existing crystal-deposit yield and mining requirements. Count finite finds once per canonical route and depth; carts use the existing container budget.
routeVariants.contextPolicy: Theme affinity only; paths outside this context still receive an underground path variant.

routeVariants.mechanic: stone-walled passage, open doorways to sentry and storage alcoves, optional traps with bypasses
routeVariants.contextPolicy: Theme affinity only; paths outside this context still receive an underground path variant.
routeVariants.layout: Two-cell central passage with stone-walled side alcoves and two-cell door openings.

routeVariants.layout: Two-cell clear middle with accessible crystal pockets at the edges. No extra cache or shrine per segment.
routeVariants.reward: Mineable sapphire crystal deposits use the existing crystal-deposit yield and pick requirement. proposedTuning.weights: relative before existing soft affinity adjustments; proposal only
proposedTuning.routeRewards: budget per canonical connected route component and depth, never per tile or segment

terrainContract: Apply a path theme to every eligible path on cave levels 1 and 2 before generic cave dressing. Use existing cave-floor path geometry; roads are never selected or carved for these variants. Parks and nexus proximity influence theme choice only.
No carve through building or water provenance, all road bands, saved structures, or excluded access regions.
Keep a per-depth geology base separate from the projected design overlay, so a shallow corridor does not silently propagate deeper.
Plan original staircase identities from the existing unmodified geology. Preserve actual stairs and reserve clear approaches before adding zone pieces.
Connect a park chamber only to a route that intersects or reaches it through eligible park floor; no straight-line connection across unrelated obstructions.
Do not close existing reachable routes to force a warren maze. Use wall-adjacent rooms and removable obstacles outside the through lane.
At seams use canonical source geometry and world positions; ambiguous or missing geometry keeps ordinary cave generation.

Seep Passage intentionally replaces eligible underground route floor with WATER. Preserve dry bank connectivity and crossings before decorating; do not paint surface roads or inherited protected water/building provenance.
Only grove surface anchors may select spring cave, goblin warrens, mushroom cavern or gemstone cavern. Seep anchors do not select these variants; quarry anchors select Mine Tunnels.
Underground nexus areas have no temple buildings. Houses and roads remain CAVE_WALL, including inside nexus coverage. Standalone Ember and Toad shrines remain small cave interactables.
economy: Anchor regions from surface geography, even when POI mirrors are pruned at an earlier depth.
Style at most one surviving mirror as the cache; retain its current chest-tier and depth rules in the first slice.
If no mirror survives, keep a spring or encounter landmark without minting a replacement chest.
Zone finds and containers replace allocated ordinary cave seats; measure total loot before tuning additional rewards.
Path intersections confer connectivity, not extra rewards or extra daily ledgers.
Use existing picked/opened/caught/treasure persistence with stable depth-qualified IDs.
One shrine per qualifying nexus region and depth, using the existing daily shrine ledger and boon rules. The boon replaces its shrine treasure gift; tile fragments never duplicate it.

Miners’ Way explicitly adds sparse bonus ore from the floor level tier. Depth 1 uses its existing copper exception; depth 2+ selects that floor tier, capped at the mineral maximum. Bonus totals need tuning before runtime activation.

Gemstone Cavern previews mixed shipping deposits and gem-bearing ore rocks. Keep their actual drop identities and mining rules; dedicated ruby, emerald and diamond deposits require new art and explicit mechanics. Gemstone Path remains sapphire-focused in this first preview.

Reuse quarry rock and sapphire appearances without importing surface quarry first-rock guarantees, buried finds or extra site rewards. Underground placements retain their declared rock/deposit rules and depth-qualified budgets.
Mine Tunnels is a simple finite ore-rich deposit per quarry anchor and depth. It creates no extra cache, shrine, temple or imported surface quarry first-rock guarantee.

implementation.deliverable: Preview source-kind mapping: grove anchors to the four grove variants, quarry anchors to Mine Tunnels, and no nexus mapping from seep. Independently theme all path geometry on cave levels 1 and 2.
Add nexus and path masks with separate depth scopes. Path themes cover every eligible path only on levels 1 and 2; exclude all roads. Preserve staircase topology and inherited geology.
Place mapped grove layouts and quarry ore deposits before generic rocks, mushrooms and enemies; preserve routes and keep house/road walls intact.
Override local EnemyHabitats.caveAt context with zone context, intersect enemy roster depth rules and reallocate existing encounter budget.
Register only selected art frames, interactions and footprints; audit economy, reachability, persistence and frame-time cost.

checks: Same source region and route across adjacent tiles and reversed load order.
Reload, player digging and surface restoration never reroll generated anchors.
Every active nexus and stair has a walkable approach; all required through routes remain connected.
No carves under excluded roads, buildings or water; no surface terrain change.
No duplicate finds, guards or caches at seams and junctions.
Depth 1 never uses deeper goblin roster entries; no empty habitat silently produces illegal enemies.
Compare capped chest totals and expected resource value against baseline cave seeds.
Check inspected art at game scale, transparent margins, frame rectangles, readable interactions and shared footprint reservation.
Every eligible path receives one theme on cave levels 1 and 2, including paths outside parks and away from nexus regions.
No underground path variant applies to roads or cave levels 3 and deeper.
Only grove anchors select the four grove nexus variants; quarry anchors select Mine Tunnels and seep anchors select none of them.
No temple or house interiors appear underground; house and road cells remain cave walls after nexus placement.
Neither nexus variants nor path themes apply at cave levels 3 or deeper.

Point-only POI coverage needs a reviewed influence radius before activation.

previewRows.name: Underground Spring Cave
previewRows.atmosphere: The spring rises at the centre of a pool. A clear bank circles the water, followed by a ring of cave mushrooms and an outer ring of mineable stone. Four openings connect the rings to the surrounding cave.
previewRows.poi: Central source supplies one surrounding pool. Refill from a reachable bank cell; any surviving mirrored cache sits on dry ground.
previewRows.connection: Concentric water, clear bank, mushroom ring and outer stone ring, with four radial approaches. No bridge across the pool is required.
previewRows.monsters: D1: cave slime / bat; D2: cave slime / bat / spider.
previewRows.source: Beneath grove nexuses only; exclude surface seep and quarry regions. wet and wooded affinities.

previewRows.name: Goblin Warrens
previewRows.atmosphere: Small 3×3 stores, narrow 3×5 rooms and larger 5×5 chambers form an enclosed network. Barrel stacks occupy room corners, leaving door approaches and the Ember shrine clear.
previewRows.poi: Ember altar inside a small inner room grants the existing fireball boon. One surviving mirrored cache stays inside the warren; shrine boon replaces the shrine gift.
previewRows.connection: Vary room width and depth independently across offset rows: 3×3 to 5×5 interiors, including narrow rectangles. Connect shared-wall doors into loops; reserve entrance, exit, stairs and shrine approaches before fitting corner stores.
previewRows.monsters: D1: club goblin; D2: club / spear goblin.
previewRows.source: Beneath grove nexuses only; exclude surface seep and quarry regions. worked and built-edge affinities.

walls.mechanic: Proposed blocking cave structure; no item drop or extra reward. Reuse the stone wall art, with topology chosen from surviving cardinal neighbors.
walls.placement: Preserve open doorways, stairs and the through route; walls are structural and counted separately from harvestable objects.
